description: WP-G4 ADVANCED FIREPOWER on the Fast Roll path. Fixture cus11e_g4_shoot (P1 Custodes' Shooting phase). The Annihilator is selected by a real token click; its carronade is assigned to the Deff Dread (VEHICLE) and its twin lastrum bolt cannon to the Gretchin (INFANTRY); a real click on 'Fast Roll All ⏩' resolves both weapons with no pause, so the free re-roll is made automatically on the first failed die against the Deff Dread only and named in the Game Log. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP; the Deff Dread's wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_DEFF_DREAD_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
